sources.role: platform frontends, input, ROM and snapshot implementation
official man page: files, key mappings, snapshots and ROMs

paths.path: ~/.fuserc is the legacy user configuration; modern builds use the libspectrum configuration mechanism and can write an XML configuration when libxml2 support is enabled
paths.naming: No stable portable controller key/value grammar is promised by the upstream man page; keyboard/joystick mappings are set in the UI or command-line options

paths.path: Configuration selected by Fuse's UI/command-line frontend
paths.naming: Emulated joystick types are Kempston, Sinclair and Cursor; physical joystick events map to INPUT_JOYSTICK_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT/FIRE_N events, while keyboard mappings use named Fuse input actions

paths.path: Fuse has no emulator battery-save directory; writable TAP/TZX/DSK/TR-DOS media are explicitly saved to the user-selected media filename
paths.naming: Media keeps its selected extension (.tap/.tzx/.dsk etc.); no universal .sav sidecar
Supported snapshot formats are .sna, .z80 and .szx; Fuse also records .rzx input recordings

paths.path: ROM images are loaded from the configured Fuse ROM directory; the source tree lists roms/*.rom
paths.naming: Exact model ROM names include 48.rom, 128-0.rom, 128-1.rom, plus2-0.rom, plus2-1.rom, plus3-0.rom through plus3-3.rom, plus3e-0.rom through plus3e-3.rom, plusd.rom and disciple.rom; no canonical checksums are published in the source

paths.path: Fuse Windows frontend configuration selected by its UI; no stable user path is documented in the upstream man page
paths.naming: Use frontend key-mapping UI; upstream does not establish a portable serialized controller grammar

paths.path: Windows frontend keyboard and joystick configuration
paths.naming: Named Fuse input actions and emulated Kempston/Sinclair/Cursor joystick events

paths.path: Writable Spectrum media is saved to its selected .tap/.tzx/.dsk/etc. file; no battery sidecar

paths.naming: Model ROMs 48.rom, 128-0.rom/128-1.rom, plus2-*.rom, plus3-*.rom and peripheral ROM names from roms/; no canonical checksums

paths.path: Fuse macOS frontend configuration selected by the Cocoa/SDL UI
paths.naming: No stable portable controller serialization is documented; use the UI mappings
Named Fuse input actions and Kempston/Sinclair/Cursor joystick events

paths.path: Writable Spectrum media files selected by the user

paths.naming: 48.rom, 128-*.rom, plus2-*.rom, plus3-*.rom and peripheral ROM names; no canonical checksum

linux-flatpak.reason: The upstream project supports Unix/Linux but does not publish a first-party Flatpak artifact.
